context.transcript:
Welcome to your first day of training. As you know,
our company specializes in commercial photography. We
provide high-quality photographs that retailers can use in
their advertisements. ®Each image we take is uploaded
to our database, and today you will learn how to use this
database to classify and sort these images. Since we're often
dealing with thousands of files at a time, we have a strict
classification system. ® Right now, you'll each be partnered
with an experienced employee who will work with you to
show you how to use the system.
